_comment: Expected dimension ranges for engine.Compute(template=classic, format=png) against the mocked octocat GraphQL fixture, rasterized by resvg (#409 Phase D). The values are an envelope, not a target. PNG/JPEG output is RasterScale=2x the SVG coordinate space for high-DPI displays, so the 480px canvas rasterizes to 960px — width_min guards that full-width canvas (SC-001); the height bounds catch a 1x1 placeholder leaking through (lower) and accidental layout explosions (upper). Since #602 the header card is an opt-in plugin; the test renders with plugin_header=yes producing the identity card alone (~94px, 2x -> ~188px).
